reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Arkansas
    Focus year: 2021 (statutes provided are 2020 versions, applicable context)
    Question: "Are eviction cases first heard in municipal court?"
*/

/* ------------------------- Scenario facts ------------------------- */

scenario_state(arkansas).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

/* The question concerns eviction cases generally (i.e., the common eviction causes of action). */
scenario_eviction_case_general(eviction_case).

/* Municipal court is the court named in the question. */
scenario_claimed_first_hearing_court(municipal_court).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement (question scenario) is present. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(arkansas),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_eviction_case_general(eviction_case),
    scenario_claimed_first_hearing_court(municipal_court).

/* ------------------------- Court taxonomy ------------------------- */

court_type(circuit_court).
court_type(district_court).
court_type(municipal_court).

/* ------------------------- Statute translations ------------------------- */

/* AR Code  18-60-306 (2020)
   (a) Forcible entries and detainers and unlawful detainers are cognizable before:
       (1) circuit court; and
       (2) district court with concurrent jurisdiction if permitted by Supreme Court rule/order.
   (b) "court" means circuit court; and if permitted, district court.
*/
permitted_by_supreme_court(district_concurrent_jurisdiction, yes).

legal_cognizable_court_18_60_306(forcible_entry_detainer, circuit_court).
legal_cognizable_court_18_60_306(unlawful_detainer, circuit_court).
legal_cognizable_court_18_60_306(forcible_entry_detainer, district_court) :-
    permitted_by_supreme_court(district_concurrent_jurisdiction, yes).
legal_cognizable_court_18_60_306(unlawful_detainer, district_court) :-
    permitted_by_supreme_court(district_concurrent_jurisdiction, yes).

/* AR Code  18-16-503 (2020)
   (b) Nuisance/criminal-offense based eviction civil action is cognizable before:
       (1) circuit court; and
       (2) district court with concurrent jurisdiction if permitted by Supreme Court rule/order.
   (c) "court" means circuit court; and if permitted, district court.
*/
legal_cognizable_court_18_16_503(nuisance_or_criminal_eviction, circuit_court).
legal_cognizable_court_18_16_503(nuisance_or_criminal_eviction, district_court) :-
    permitted_by_supreme_court(district_concurrent_jurisdiction, yes).

/* AR Code  18-17-701 (2020)
   (c)(1) Landlord may obtain ... judgments, or evictions in circuit court or district court
          for any noncompliance by the tenant with the rental agreement.
*/
legal_cognizable_court_18_17_701(tenant_noncompliance_eviction, circuit_court).
legal_cognizable_court_18_17_701(tenant_noncompliance_eviction, district_court).

/* AR Code  18-17-203 (2020)
   "The district court or appropriate court of this state shall exercise jurisdiction ..."
   This supports district-court jurisdiction generally, but does not identify municipal court
   as the eviction forum.
*/
legal_jurisdiction_18_17_203(district_court).

/* ------------------------- Consolidated legal reasoning ------------------------- */

/* Define the eviction case types covered by the provided eviction-related statutes. */
eviction_case_type(forcible_entry_detainer).
eviction_case_type(unlawful_detainer).
eviction_case_type(nuisance_or_criminal_eviction).
eviction_case_type(tenant_noncompliance_eviction).

/* A court is legally authorized (cognizable forum) for an eviction case type if any statute grants it. */
legal_eviction_cognizable_in(CaseType, Court) :-
    eviction_case_type(CaseType),
    court_type(Court),
    legal_cognizable_court_18_60_306(CaseType, Court).
legal_eviction_cognizable_in(CaseType, Court) :-
    eviction_case_type(CaseType),
    court_type(Court),
    legal_cognizable_court_18_16_503(CaseType, Court).
legal_eviction_cognizable_in(CaseType, Court) :-
    eviction_case_type(CaseType),
    court_type(Court),
    legal_cognizable_court_18_17_701(CaseType, Court).

/* Municipal court is "a court where eviction cases are first heard" only if it is a cognizable forum
   for eviction actions under the provided statutes. */
municipal_court_has_eviction_jurisdiction :-
    legal_eviction_cognizable_in(_AnyEvictionCaseType, municipal_court).

/* ------------------------- Answer ------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    municipal_court_has_eviction_jurisdiction,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ municipal_court_has_eviction_jurisdiction,
    !.

/* ------------------------- Main entrypoint ------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in municipal court?
